name: Bendy and the Ink Factory
storyline:
The final conclusion to the Bendy trilogy arrives, completing the dark adventure that began in “Bendy and the Ink Machine” and deepened in “Bendy and the Dark Revival”. As the final installment in this iconic horror series, “Bendy and the Ink Factory” returns to present the ultimate climax to years of ink-stained mysteries, heart-pounding chases, and unforgettable characters that have captivated millions of fans worldwide.

Descend into the infamous Joey Drew Studios once more, where cartoon nightmares come to life, rising from their dark puddles. Survive the horrific challenges of two worlds, bound by ink and a terrible machine. With a legacy of atmospheric storytelling, eerily beautiful hand-drawn visuals, and sudden encounters, “Bendy and the Ink Factory” returns to the series' rubberhose roots with an even darker, even inkier horror adventure.

Everything must end.
summary: Bendy and the Ink Factory is a first-person survival horror. Return to the world of Joey Drew Studios like never before. The dark truth is hanging in the shadows... waiting to devour you. The rubberhose nightmare continues.. But eventually, everything must end.
